profile_text.body:
Anysphere is a software company founded in 2023 that operates under the Cursor brand at cursor.com. The company describes itself as building tools to make developers "extraordinarily productive," with its core product being an AI-powered integrated development environment marketed as an AI coding agent.

Cursor is Anysphere's flagship product, categorized as a coding and developer tool. The site presents it as an IDE in which AI agents can take on development tasks, with users able to choose between targeted edits and fully autonomous agentic operation. The site includes testimonials describing Cursor as used across organizations of roughly 40,000 engineers and praising features such as autocomplete, keyboard shortcuts, and the ability to bring a user's own model.

The held facts note that Cursor carries a flagged consideration around source-code exposure, which is relevant context for enterprise users evaluating the product. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded for Anysphere at this time.
